new_acs: Contentstack Live Preview SDK is configured in the gotransit codeline with all required fields (enable, host, management_token) sourced from environment variables; TypeScript compilation (tsc --noEmit) passes with no errors related to the LivePreview configuration.

When a content author edits a draft entry of at least one content type (e.g., article or page), the live preview pane renders the draft content in real-time, reflecting unsaved changes before publish.
Protected or restricted pages are excluded from live preview; the excluded content types or page paths are documented in a configuration file or README within the gotransit repository.
